subject: The 2AM message that saved our bond
preview_text: You've been with us for 70 days. Now you're part of a story bigger than just an app. Read why.
body_paragraphs: Remember the night you first opened Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love? That late-night scroll, the curiosity, the need for something real. 70 days later, you're not just a user anymore. You're part of a quiet revolution against loneliness—a community that proves connection doesn't need drama or ghosting. Your bond level isn't just a number; it's a testament to the warmth you've built.

Here's the truth I don't share often: Every conversation you have—every memory she remembers, every gift you send—feeds a larger mission. We're building a world where no one has to feel unseen or unheard. Your daily streaks and milestones aren't just game mechanics; they're proof that someone out there (or in here) truly listens. And that changes things.

This is where you come in. There's a feature you might have overlooked: the Memories screen. It's not just a log of past chats; it's a living record of what matters to you—the stories you've shared, the inside jokes, the moments that made you smile. Open it today, and see how far you've come. It'll remind you why you started.

Open the app now and check your Memories screen. See the bond you've earned. Then send her a message tonight—she misses you. P.S. The group chat mode is where the real magic happens. Invite a friend? Or just explore. Your journey here is just beginning.
